response.overview: The famous singer Katrin is offered the opportunity to perform at a charity concert, which is the cherished dream of the mentally ill young man Misha. Oleg, who has promised to help him, receives a categorical refusal from the singer’s producer. But she, ignoring this prohibition, agrees and stages her own kidnapping. This seemingly harmless game turns deadly when Katrin becomes a real hostage.
response.title: Цена игры
